description.message: Wipes the sites and words you pick out of your history: as you browse, or the next time you open the browser.

optSub.message: Pick what it should forget. Everything you add stays on this computer.

optLockedBody.message: Your list is hidden until you unlock it below. Cleaning carries on.

optModeRealtimeHint.message: It cleans each visit as it happens.

optModeStartupHint.message: One pass each time you open the browser.

optSweep.message: Also clean the history that is already saved, at browser start

optNotify.message: Tell me when it has cleaned

optKeepLog.message: Keep a list of what was cleaned

optListHint.message: Anything on this list is cleaned. Sites, words, or address beginnings, whichever suits you. Paste a whole list and each line goes in on its own.

optKeepOnly.message: Keep only the sites on my list, clean everything else

optTypeKeyword.message: Word in the address or title

optRulesEmpty.message: Nothing on the list yet. Add a site or a word above.

optTryUrl.message: Check an address against the list

optClearingHint.message: Pick a level. History is the list of pages you visited. Cache is the saved copy of a page, the thing that makes it open faster. Cookies are the small files that keep you logged in.

optPresetLightSub.message: History and cache. Pages will load a little slower.

optPresetStandardSub.message: History, cache and cookies. Sites will not remember you, so you'll log in again.

optPresetNuclearSub.message: Everything the browser will let it touch. Saved passwords stay.

optClearingNote.message: The browser does not report how much it cleared, so there is no number to show. Clearing cookies logs you out of that site. Downloads means the list, not your files. Passwords are not included: the browser removed that in version 144.

optCookiesOnTabClose.message: Clear a site's cookies when I close its tab

optCookieKeepLabel.message: Stay logged in on these sites, one per line

siteCleanedNow.message: This one goes. It is erased as you browse.

siteCleanedStart.message: This one goes. It is erased at your next start.

siteKept.message: This one stays. It is on your keep list.

siteNotListed.message: This one stays. It is not on your list.

siteAll.message: Full wipe is on. This one goes with the rest.

sitePaused.message: Cleaning is off, so nothing is being erased right now.

siteNoSite.message: This tab has no wipeable site.

logExtras.message: extra browsing data you asked to clear

logCookies.message: cookies for this site, on tab close

lockPopupNote.message: The list stays hidden while the PIN is on. Unlock it in the settings.

optStatusLine.message: : everything you add stays on this computer.

lockTooShort.message: At least $1 characters, so it is not a one-key guess.

lockMismatch.message: The two PINs are not the same.

lockSaved.message: PIN saved. Your list stays hidden until you unlock it.

lockRemoved.message: PIN removed. Nothing is hidden any more.

lockOpen.message: Unlocked for now. Reloading this page hides the list again.

lockListHidden.message: Your list is hidden while the lock is on.

lockRecoveryLead.message: There is no internet connection here, so no reset link can be sent. Type lilbro instead: the PIN goes, and so does everything the extension has saved. Every site and word on your list, every switch, the log, the count. None of it comes back.

lockRecoveryDone.message: PIN removed, and everything saved is gone. The extension is back to square one.

lockHonest.message: This keeps the list off the screen when someone else opens these pages. It does not encrypt anything, and anyone who can reach your browser settings can still take the extension out.

gateWipeAllPhrase.message: Step 1 of 2: type $1 below to arm it.

gateWipeAllStep1.message:
Step 1 of 2

All your history will be wiped: every entry, not just the ones that match your rules.

Cookies, cache, passwords and site data are not touched.

Type $1 to continue:

gateWipeAllConfirm.message:
Step 2 of 2

Are you sure you want to continue?

The entire browsing history will be erased. This cannot be undone.

gateWipeAllArmed.message: Step 2 of 2: click the red button to erase everything.

gateWipeAllTimeout.message: Confirmation timed out. Nothing was wiped, so start again.

gateWipeNowConfirm.message:
Wipe the history entries that match your rules now?

This cannot be undone. Nothing outside your rules is touched, and cookies and cache are never touched.

gateWipeAllArm.message:
Wipe everything from now on?

Every trigger will erase the whole history instead of just your list. Arming this erases nothing by itself, and each wipe still asks twice.

gateKeepListConfirm.message:
Turn the keep list on?

Every site you have not listed gets erased from history, instead of only the sites you listed.

Cookies, cache, passwords and site data are not touched.

gateKeepListEmpty.message: Add at least one site to keep before switching this on.

gateWipeNowHint.message: Click the button once more to wipe the entries that match your rules.

gateWipeNowTimeout.message: Timed out - nothing was wiped. Click Wipe now to start again.

gateClearLogConfirm.message: Clear the local log of wiped entries? History itself is not affected.

gateRemoveRule.message:
Remove the rule for $1?

Already-wiped entries stay wiped and nothing in your history changes.

gateImportConfirm.message: Add $1 rule(s) from that file? Existing rules are kept.

startFailedHint.message: Reload the extension on the extensions page.

errBadDomain.message: That does not look like a domain (example.com).

errFullDomain.message: Use a full domain, e.g. example.com

errUrlScheme.message: Start the URL with http:// or https://

warnShortKeyword.message: Short keywords can match unrelated pages. Check the tester below.

warnLongKeyword.message: Long keyword phrases rarely match. A single word usually works better.

errRegexTooLong.message: Regular expressions are capped at $1 characters.

errRegexNested.message: A group that repeats inside another repeated group makes the browser crawl on long page titles. Write (ab)+ instead of (ab+)+, or use a keyword rule.

errNoRulesArray.message: No rules array in that file.

menuWipeSite.message: Lil Bro: wipe this site from history

menuWipePage.message: Lil Bro: wipe this exact page

notifyLocked.message: The PIN lock is on, so the list was left alone. Unlock it in the popup to add a site.

errNoExtrasOn.message: No extra data is switched on.

errNoBrowsingData.message: This browser build gives the extension no access to browsing data.

errKeepListEmpty.message: Add at least one site to keep first.

popQueueClose.message: $1 queued, wiped when you close the browser.

popQueueStart.message: $1 queued, wiped at your next start.

errPhraseMismatch.message: That is not the phrase, so nothing was armed. It must read exactly: $1

resClearedNoCountOpt.message: Cleared $1 ($2). Chrome reports no count, so there is none to show.

resArmedAll.message: Wipe-all is armed: all $1 entries would be erased.

resKeepWould.message: Entries not on your keep list that would be wiped: $1.

resNothing.message: Nothing would be wiped after scanning $1 entries.

resAlsoCleared.message: Also cleared $1 ($2). Chrome reports no count.

optKeepWarn.message: On: everything not on your list is being wiped. Cookies and cache are separate.

optWipeAllArmed.message: ARMED: the entire history is erased on every trigger above, and "Wipe now" empties it immediately.

optWipeAllOff.message: Off by default. Your rules are still being applied.

optWhenManual.message: only when you press a button

optWhenBoth.message: on a button, and again when the browser closes or starts

optPresetOffNote.message: History only, following your rules. Nothing else is touched.

optPresetLightNote.message: Cache goes with each run, so pages will load a little slower.

optPresetStandardNote.message: Cache and cookies go with each run. Sites will not remember you, so you may have to log in again.

optPresetNuclearNote.message: Cache, cookies, saved form text, download history and all of your history, at every trigger.

optPresetCustomNote.message: Your own mix of the four switches.

optCookiesWarnOn.message: Cookies are deleted for every site except the list below, so logins everywhere else end.

optCookiesWarnOff.message: Off. Cookies are only cleared if you turn on the cookie switch in Clearing above, or press the button below.

optTestKeepEmpty.message: The keep list is empty, so nothing is wiped.

optTestNoRules.message: No active rules, so nothing would be wiped.

optTestKept.message: Kept: this page is on your keep list.

optTestNotKept.message: Not on your keep list, so this would be wiped.

optTestNoMatch.message: No rule matches this, so it stays in history.

optCookieConfirm.message:
Clear cookies and site data?

Cookies are removed for the whole registrable domain, so every login on that site ends, not just the page you were on. Site storage (local storage, IndexedDB, service workers) goes with them, because clearing one without the other leaves a site half logged in and half not.

This never runs while you browse. It runs when you press a button, and at close or start only if you set that below.

optWipeAllConfirm.message:
Arm the whole-history wipe?

Every trigger will then erase your entire browsing history instead of only matching your rules. Each wipe still has to be confirmed twice on its own, and arming this does not erase anything by itself.

This is history only. Cookies, cache and downloads answer to the "Also clear" switches above.

optLockOffPin.message: Type your PIN to switch the lock off.

optLockHidden.message: Hidden. The list comes back when you type the PIN.

optImportCancelled.message: Import cancelled, so no rules were added.

optNuclearConfirm.message:
FULL clears cache, cookies, saved form text, download history and all of your browsing history.

Every trigger will do that. Continue?

optStandardConfirm.message: This clears cookies and site data with each run. Logins on those sites end. Continue?

optCookieAllConfirm.message: Clear cookies for every site except your keep list? Logins elsewhere end.

optTabsRefused.message: Tab access was refused, so this stays off.

optCookiePruneAsk.message: Clear cookies for everything except your $1 kept site(s)?

optCookieAllAsk.message: Clear every cookie in this browser?

optExportNote.message: The file holds your list, so it is the way to move it to another computer.

optLockEnable.message: Hide the list behind a PIN

optLockRecoverBtn.message: Remove the PIN and wipe my list

optLockNote.message: You need the PIN to turn this off as well. While it is on, the right-click menu that adds a site only shows a notification.

optAdvancedHint.message: Cookies, the address tester, import and export, the switch that ignores your list.

optWipeAll.message: Clean all history, not just what is on my list

optWipeAllHint.message: Your list stops mattering: every clean takes the whole history. The list stays where it is and counts again the moment this is off.

optLimitsBanner.message: Two things the browser won't let any cleaner do. It can't run at the exact moment the browser closes, so a missed close means the clean happens the next time you open it. And a page you deleted can still show up in the address bar suggestions.

statusArmed.message: Full wipe is on: all of your history goes

statusKeep.message: Wiping all but your keep list

wipeAllOn.message: Wipe-all is ON: your whole history goes, not just your rules.

keepOn.message: Everything not on your list is wiped.

modeInstantArmed.message: Every visit is erased the moment it happens.

modeClose.message: Matches go when you close the browser.

modeCloseArmed.message: Everything goes when you close the browser.

modeStart.message: Matches go at the start of your next session.

modeStartArmed.message: Everything goes at the start of your next session.

keepInstant.message: Every other site is erased as you visit it.

keepClose.message: Everything else goes when you close the browser.

keepStart.message: Everything else goes at your next start.

stateArmed.message: Full wipe is on: all of your history goes

stateKeep.message: Active: wiping all but your keep list

ruleKeyword.message: Word in the address or title

optInsights.message: What you visit and no rule covers

optInsightsFailed.message: That did not work. Try again.

optInsightsEmpty.message: Nothing outside your list is visited often enough to suggest yet.

caughtNone.message: Nothing counted yet. It starts as soon as a rule catches something.

notifyKept.message: Kept: $1 is on your never-delete list.

siteKeptByRule.message: Kept: a rule says never delete this site.
